title: My sat nav said I had arrived in my bedroom 🧭
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 1:45 in the morning my sat nav said, you have arrived, inside my bedroom.

scenes.narration: At 1:45 in the morning my sat nav said, you have arrived, inside my bedroom.
I was in bed. The phone was on the nightstand. The calm voice said it again. You have arrived at your destination.
I opened the app. A tiny blue arrow sat on my bed. A red pin sat at the foot of it. And the pin was moving closer.
Route recalculating, said the voice. Turn left. I looked left. A wardrobe. In the mirror on its door, nothing at all.
In two hundred metres, you will arrive at your destination. But the room is four metres across.
The voice kept counting down. One hundred. Fifty. Ten. Each time, my own breathing felt louder.
You have arrived, it said. And then, in a different voice, in my own, a little hoarse. Thanks for the lift. I was lost for years, and you were so easy to follow home.
So tell me. Do you turn the phone off, or answer it?
